capability: Rollback-safe version-scoped launcher activation behind one immutable Bootstrap trust anchor
searchEvidence: Existing ManagedActivationCoordinator is the sole app activation/rollback owner; Launcher self-update is explicitly absent from ADR 0051 and v0.10.6 spec before this approved amendment.
JsonVersionManagerStateStore and FileSystemVersionManagerWriteLease own the exact normalized app state path and the only OS-backed writer identity.
AnonymousPipeManagedApplicationProcess owns app READY transport, while StableLauncherHandoff currently starts one root launcher without custom state-path propagation.
ManagedPackageVerifier and release-manifest-v1 are the sole closed installed-payload identity authorities; no launcher identity verifier or durable launcher journal exists.
rg -n 'Launcher|Bootstrap|state-path|READY|DeleteAsync' across src/tests/docs found no second launcher update state machine or hidden updater.
semanticOwner: VersionManagement Application launcher bootstrap coordinator over the existing exact version-state writer lease; Infrastructure only persists/verifies/launches typed identities
terminalContract: Immutable root Bootstrap selects only the fully verified protocol-1 launcher coupled to the exact already-committed active app admission; it never overwrites itself or a running launcher, never scans for fallback, serializes both journals through the exact existing state-path lease, propagates the exact custom state path to Launcher and Desktop, commits candidate only after nested app READY plus outer exact-admission READY and post-commit reload, and on uncertain/failing start advances at most once to the exact previous verified launcher. App mutation is fenced while launcher pending, and active/pending owner admission deletion is blocked while LKG owner deletion first durably retires rollback.

designReview.evidence: Independent R2 review approved ADR 0056 after requiring exact owner admission/manifest binding, injective launcher-state derivation, committed-active-only selection, protocol-aware app mutation fence, exact custom state-path propagation, outer READY revalidation, LKG retire-before-delete compatibility, and closed mandatory crash/tamper/protocol tests.
